order: exposure gain once in linear RGB

definitions.exposureEV: Relative to frozen current engine reference E0; gain=2^EV. Not absolute camera EV or measured lux.
definitions.contrast: linear luminance contrast around .18 reference pivot, slope; clamp only at final tone mapper
definitions.saturation: linear gray-to-color mixing factor, 1 unchanged; percent=(factor-1)*100
definitions.warmth: authored diagonal RGB grade, red=1+warmthPercent/200, green=1, blue=1-warmthPercent/200; illustrative, not Kelvin or mired
definitions.shadowStrength: 1-shadowToLitLinearLuminanceRatio on neutral patch; achieved through direct/fill balance, not black overlay
